sourceFindings.title: Workspace-name and npm-alias shortcuts erase physically reachable installed successors
sourceFindings.contract: Retain declared metadata edges AND physical successors resolved by trusted createRequire(declaringManifest).resolve.paths(declaredKey), in actor context. Unknown implementation and canonical identity failures remain blocking.
sourceFindings.expected: Known installed product metadata -> FAIL; neutral unproved installed implementation -> INCOMPLETE; outside canonical identity -> fail closed.
sourceFindings.observed: 20 false PASS API cases: 12 known product paths, 4 unproved installed implementations, 4 outside canonical symlinks. Same outcomes independently reproduced by CLI, in all four fields.
sourceFindings.cause: The workspaces.get(targetName) branch bypasses installedPackage(pkgFile,name). Its workspace edge replaces rather than supplements the physical declared-key lookup, so nested lookup priority, metadata and canonical identity are not checked.

sourceFindings.requiredCorrection: Always retain the resolved physical successor alongside any declared workspace/alias edge. Resolve using the declared installation key and declaring actor, preserve lookup order/canonical identity, and keep unknown implementation blocking.

sourceFindings.title: Missing explicit workspace erases a physically known product identity
sourceFindings.contract: A missing explicit workspace is INCOMPLETE, but a reachable known product must be FAIL; metadata must not erase a physical successor.
sourceFindings.expected: FAIL with product witness, retaining any separate missing-workspace diagnostic.
sourceFindings.observed: Four fields: next:workspace:* has no named workspace, while node_modules/next canonically points to products/consumer. API/CLI return INCOMPLETE with only UNVERIFIED_WORKSPACE_DEPENDENCY and no product witness. Exit 1 remains blocking; this is a classification/graph defect, not a false PASS.
sourceFindings.requiredCorrection: Retain explicit-workspace uncertainty and still inspect any reachable physical installed identity; product reachability takes precedence for status.

sourceFindings.title: JSON-less installed directories omit their reachable nested dependency metadata
sourceFindings.contract: Canonical installed identity and unproved implementation are separate from recursive installed dependency-metadata graph coverage, including nested dist manifests.
sourceFindings.expected: Known nested product -> FAIL; malformed nested package manifest -> fail closed with validation evidence.
sourceFindings.observed: Eight cases across all four fields: node_modules/next has no root package.json but owns dist/package.json. Product dependencies and invalid [] manifests are never inspected; both return only UNVERIFIED_INSTALLED_DEPENDENCY/INCOMPLETE. The implementation frontier remains blocked, but product classification and metadata coverage are lost. Native CLI reproduces all eight.
sourceFindings.requiredCorrection: Govern/census the reached canonical installed directory even without a top-level manifest, retain nested manifest edges/validation, and independently preserve the JSON-less unproved implementation diagnostic.
